normative_extracts.quote: HiddenClasses (Maps) store property descriptors and offsets so property loads compile to direct memory offsets.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Inline Caches specialize property accesses based on observed object Shapes.

production_failures.symptom: 10x slowdown in a parser or data grid engine
production_failures.root_cause: Properties added conditionally in varying order turning the IC megamorphic.
production_failures.mitigation: Initialize all properties in the constructor in a fixed order.

production_failures.symptom: Throughput drop after using delete obj.key
production_failures.root_cause: Downgrading the object to dictionary mode (Slow Mode).
production_failures.mitigation: Assign obj.key = undefined instead of delete.
